title: Dapper Toddler Boy in White Suit & Bowtie, 1950s Outdoor Vintage Photo
description: A charming full-length portrait of a young boy posing outdoors on a sunny day in front of a home's entryway. He is dressed in mid-century children's formal wear, featuring a short-sleeved white jacket with contrasting piping, a dark bowtie, matching white shorts, white ankle socks, and white walking shoes. A sharp shadow is cast on the concrete walkway beside him.
